title: Hierarchical Time Series Forecasting with Operator-Valued Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.18196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical time series forecasting requires generating accurate predictions that are coherent across multiple levels of aggregation. Existing methods either rely on two-stage pipelines with post-hoc reconciliation or on end-to-end models that often lack statistical guarantees. We introduce a unified framework that formulates hierarchical forecasting as a multivariate regression problem in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space. By designing structured operator-valued kernels, our approach enforces coherence directly within the hypothesis space, ensuring that all predictions satisfy hierarchical constraints by construction. We further propose tailored kernel constructions for hierarchical data and derive excess risk bounds that characterize generalization performance. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the relevance of the proposed method.

translated_title: 基于算子值核的层次时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 层次时间序列预测要求生成在多个聚合层级上保持一致（coherent）的准确预测。现有方法要么依赖带有事后协调（reconciliation）步骤的两阶段流水线，要么依赖通常缺乏统计保证的端到端模型。我们引入了一个统一框架，将层次预测表述为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的多元回归问题。通过设计结构化的算子值核，我们的方法直接在假设空间内强制实施一致性，从而确保所有预测在构造上即满足层次约束。我们进一步为层次数据提出了专门的核构造方法，并推导出刻画泛化性能的过剩风险界（excess risk bounds）。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实证结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于结构化算子值核的统一框架，将层次时间序列预测转化为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间中的多元回归问题，使预测在构造上即满足层次一致性约束，无需事后协调步骤，并给出了泛化性能的过剩风险理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework using structured operator-valued kernels that formulates hierarchical time series forecasting as multivariate regression in a vector-valued RKHS, ensuring hierarchical coherence by construction without post-hoc reconciliation, and provides excess risk bounds for generalization guarantees.
